name: smart-hiv
_comment: Declares ONLY smart-hiv's bibliography (owner, 2026-11-02, card Q-REFKG-3 A: "smart-hiv now, pcmt later" -- a small smart-hiv.json that declares only a references folder). The earlier ruling still holds: smart-hiv does not carry a harness of its own (owner 2026-10-14: "Smart-hiv doesn't need its own harness. It can just define index.config.json and reference smart-base as a dependency"); this file names nothing but the references directory the site's KG Bibliography page reads.
title: WHO SMART Guidelines — HIV
description: The WHO SMART Guidelines HIV implementation guide (FHIR IG source under input/). Declared only for its bibliography.

directories.description: smart-hiv's bibliography: one folio-reference/v1 CSL-JSON entry per cited work, `<key>.json`. The IG is one document with one bibliography page, the KG Bibliography the site publishes (`en/folio-assistant-core/bibliography/`, the IG menu's Bibliography item); the IG pages hold no reference lists of their own, and each in-text citation links to its entry there as `en/folio-assistant-core/bibliography/references/<key>/`. smart-base's `check:ig-citations` fails on a citation with no entry, a page reference list, or a reference-section link to a work this directory does not hold
